recommendation.headline: Use CLARABEL + dual extraction for the headline result.
rationale: SDPA-GMP installs cleanly via pip (sdpa-multiprecision) and works for tiny problems
BUT runtime is 100-1000x slower than CLARABEL; row 4 at N=2000 T=800 bochner_n=20 not feasible
AND default GMP solve fails on a ~7000-variable instance (bochner_n=10 N=200)
CLARABEL's optimal_inaccurate status with dual lower bound is the rigorous-yet-tractable path

Where SDPA-GMP COULD help: tiny verification runs to spot-check that CLARABEL's reported value at intermediate sizes (e.g. N=100) agrees with multiprecision to within 1e-9 — confirmed here (5e-9 agreement)
